bull_bear.body:
- Material uncertainty related to going concern — The statutory auditor drew attention to note 17(VII): accumulated losses and net current liabilities indicate the existence of material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. Management relies on business strategies and operating plans as mitigating factors and the opinion is not modified, but the emphasis is repeated for FY26 with FY25 comparatives.
- No turnover at the standalone entity — The MD&A key-ratio table states that debtors turnover, inventory turnover, operating profit margin and net profit margin are not applicable 'since Company did not record any turnover during the year' ended March 31, 2026 — the operating base is effectively nil at the parent level.
- Single-segment / single-activity concentration — Operations are presently concentrated in one business segment (investment-related operations, consultancy and allied commercial activities), so there is no internal diversification to absorb a downturn in that activity; the Company itself notes segment-wise reporting is not applicable.
- Capital-market and macroeconomic volatility — MD&A Risks and Concerns: fluctuations in capital markets, interest rates, inflation, changes in economic conditions and global economic uncertainties may adversely impact business sentiment, investment activity and the Company's operational and financial performance — direct exposure for an investment-led business.
- Regulatory and compliance change — Evolving regulatory and compliance requirements — changes in taxation policies, corporate governance standards and disclosure norms — may increase operational and compliance costs; adverse changes in regulatory frameworks may affect growth prospects.
- Intense competition from established financial institutions and technology-driven providers — MD&A Threats: competition from established financial institutions, advisory firms and technology-driven service providers may affect profitability and market positioning.
- Technology change and cyber-security — Rapid technological advancement and digital transformation require continuous investment in systems, cyber-security and process upgrades; the Company also flags evolving customer expectations within the financial and commercial services sector.
- Very small operating organisation — The number of people employed during the financial year under consideration is stated as 3, with no material development in Human Resources during the year — execution capacity and key-person dependence are structurally constrained relative to the stated ambition to pursue growth opportunities.
